primitives.name: Athletic Competition Status Discontinuity
primitives.verbatim_quote: APPENDIX 289 To prevent any misunderstanding in reading the above, attention is called to the following explanation : An athlete has forfeited his right to compete as an amateur, and has thereby become a professional by — (a) Ever have competed in an open competition, i.
primitives.assumptions: Assumes a binary amateur/professional classification, with a sharp threshold at first participation in any open-entry athletic competition regardless of prize structure.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Discontinuity occurs at the exact moment of first participation in an open competition; no gradual transition modeled.

layer2.mapping: Maps the discrete amateur-to-professional status change to a conformal inference boundary crossing, where the athlete's eligibility region shifts from 'amateur permitted' to 'professional prohibited'.
layer2.telemetry: First observed participation event in an open-entry athletic competition serves as the empirical verification metric.

primitives.verbatim_quote: (b) Ever having compéted for money in any athletic exercise.
primitives.assumptions: Assumes that monetary compensation constitutes a sufficient condition for professional status, independent of other factors.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Any instance of receiving payment triggers immediate forfeiture; no tolerance for small amounts or occasional payments.

layer2.mapping: Derives a set-theoretic kernel from the forfeiture criteria, defining the space of permissible versus impermissible financial transactions within athletic contexts.
layer2.telemetry: Recorded financial transactions exceeding zero constitute the observable data for monitoring compliance.

primitives.name: Compensation Definition Hierarchy
primitives.verbatim_quote: (f) Ever having directly or indirectly accepted or received remuneration for engaging in any athletic exercise.
primitives.assumptions: Considers both direct and indirect forms of remuneration equivalent in triggering professional status, without distinction between types of compensation.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Any form of remuneration, regardless of structure or amount, results in the same discrete status change.

layer2.mapping: Maps the hierarchical compensation definitions to a Bayesian network node representing the probability distribution over different compensation structures, allowing for probabilistic assessment of compliance risk.
layer2.telemetry: Classification of compensation types (direct vs indirect) provides telemetry for updating belief states about an athlete's professional status.
